vulnerability_title: [M-06] changeRanges silently fails when price is out of tick range, sending all liquidity to treasury instead of creating new position

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: changeRanges removes all liquidity, collects the tokens, and mints a new position only if both amounts are above zero, with no else branch. It then always calls _manageUtilityAmounts with MAX_BPS, which sends every token to the treasury, and mapPoolAddressPositionIds keeps the old position id.
patterns_found: if (amounts[0] > 0 && amounts[1] > 0) with no else branch at line 770
_manageUtilityAmounts(tokens, MAX_BPS, false) sends all leftover tokens to the treasury
position id mapping not updated when no new position is minted

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: silent failure in changeRanges sends all liquidity to the treasury
